---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today? Describe the pain, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it's UI, a sketch or reference helps.

## Could this be a plugin or theme instead?

WordJS is designed to be extended without core changes. If your idea could ship as a **plugin**
(routes, hooks, `versoComponents`) or a **theme** (`style.css` + `--wjs-*` tokens), say so — it may not
need to live in core at all.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one is better.

## Scope

- [ ] I'd be willing to work on this
- [ ] This is a small, self-contained change
- [ ] This would touch core (`backend/src/core/*`)
